description: This file is a script written in JavaScript, meant to be run with Node.js. It performs static analysis on TypeScript source files to detect references to specific pairing-store identifiers and enforce architectural constraints related to group authorization logic.

methods.name: getDeclarationNameText
methods.description: Extracts the textual name of variable or binding pattern declarations from the AST node.

methods.name: containsPairingStoreSource
methods.description: Recursively checks whether a given AST node contains references to pairing-store related identifiers or function calls.

methods.name: getCallName
methods.description: Retrieves the function/method name from a call expression node.

methods.name: isSuspiciousNormalizeWithStoreCall
methods.description: Detects specific calls to normalizeAllowFromWithStore with pairing-store entries in their arguments.

methods.name: findViolations
methods.description: Performs static analysis on the source content to find violations where group scope bindings reference pairing-store identifiers outside allowed patterns.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that runs the analysis and reports violations, exit with error if violations are found.
